headline: Willis Towers Watson (WTW) Looks Fully Valued As Q2 Beat And Propel AI Lift Sentiment
summary: Willis Towers Watson (WTW) is back in focus after Q2 2026 results topped analyst revenue and earnings expectations, alongside the launch of its Propel AI cost efficiency program and reaffirmed multi year guidance. See our latest analysis for Willis Towers Watson. The share price reaction has been strong, with Willis Towers Watson up 13.8% over the past week and 22.1% over the past month. The 1 year total shareholder return of 8.1% and 3 year total shareholder return of 64.0% point to momentum...
